item.name: Gold
item.obtainment: 1% chance to grow, replacing the normal variant. The odds can be increased by the Pig, Praying Mantis and Bacon Pig pet. The odds can be increased by using Sprinklers. It can also be applied by the Super Seed. This only works on crops, not harvested produce. It can also raise the odds of the produce becoming Gold. It can also be applied by the Dragonfly, Cockatrice or the Golden Bee pet. It can also be applied by the Golden Bee pet when harvesting a crop. It can also be applied by using the Gold Fertilizer. This only works on crops, not harvested produce. It can also raise the odds of the produce becoming Gold.
item.visualDescription: Bright and reflective. Gold in color. It gives off a shimmering sound.

item.name: Rainbow
item.obtainment: 0.1% chance to grow, replacing the normal variant. The odds can be increased by using Pig, Praying Mantis and Bacon Pig pet. The odds can be increased by using Sprinklers. It can also be applied by the Super Seed. This only works on crops, not harvested produce. It can also raise the odds of the produce becoming Rainbow. It can also be applied by the Butterfly pet when a crop has 5+ environmental mutations. If the Butterfly applies Rainbow this way, all previous mutations will be removed. It can also be applied by using the Rainbow Fertilizer. This only works on crops, not harvested produce. It increases the produce's chances of being Rainbow. During Rainbow.
item.visualDescription: Continuously shifts through rainbow colors. Yellow particles appear along with a rainbow overhead.
